entries.en: Hiho, fellow knight |PLAYERNAME|!
entries.translated: Ciao, compagno cavaliere |PLAYERNAME|!

entries.en: Goodbye.
entries.translated: Arrivederci.

entries.en: Be carefull out there, jawoll.
entries.translated: Stai attento là fuori, jawoll.

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
entries.translated: Chi sei? Cosa vuoi? Sembri troppo esperto per diventare mio assistente. Per favore, vattene.

entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
entries.translated: Ciao |PLAYERNAME|! Hai bisogno di qualche attrezzatura per la tua casa?

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
entries.translated: Dai un'occhiata. La maggior parte dei mobili viene fornita in pratici kit. Usali a casa tua per assemblare i mobili. Vuoi vedere solo un certo {type} di mobili?

entries.en: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
entries.translated: Questo mondo non è niente senza la poesia, non credi? Ci dà speranza, invoca amore. È stimolante e rinvigorente allo stesso tempo.

entries.en: Goodbye and farewell, my friend.
entries.translated: Arrivederci e addio, amico mio.

entries.en: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
entries.translated: Oh, ciao |PLAYERNAME|! Che carino da parte tua far visita a un vecchio come me.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Torna ogni volta che hai bisogno di saggezza.

entries.en: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
entries.translated: Torna ogni volta che hai bisogno di saggezza.

entries.en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

entries.en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
entries.translated: SÌ? Cosa posso fare per te, |PLAYERNAME|? Affari bancari, forse?

entries.en: Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
entries.translated: Benvenuto nella gilda dei paladini, |PLAYERNAME|! Come posso aiutarla?

entries.en: Asha Thrazi, stranger!
entries.translated: Asha Thrazi, straniera!

entries.en: Asha Thrazi, stranger!
entries.translated: Asha Thrazi, straniera!

entries.en: Be greeted. What brings you {here}?
entries.translated: Fatti salutare. Cosa ti porta {here}?

entries.en: Oh well.
entries.translated: Vabbè.
